امتثلنا (form VIII)
# اِمْتَثَلْنَا (imtaṯalnā) /im.ta.θal.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
# اُمْتُثِلْنَا (umtuṯilnā) /um.tu.θil.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
